text:
mira_infra: FYI spinning up asia-east1 (prod-ish) cluster for inference fleet. Need artifact propagation & GitOps pipeline verification before handoff.

chen_sre: What's current status of registry sync? Last replication job failed in us-west with 503s.

mira_infra: Started registry-sync job 1799004322, using registry-sync v1.2 (our custom tool). Logs attached:
```
[2026-03-18T14:05:12Z] INFO starting sync from gcr.io/redwood-artifacts -> asia-east1.registry.redwood
[2026-03-18T14:05:15Z] WARN 503 transient on get manifest, retrying
[2026-03-18T14:06:02Z] INFO replicated 42 images, 3 skipped (already present)
```

alex_dev: did you push helm charts to the charts repo? Flux will look at `git@github.com:redwood/charts.git` on branch `region/asia-east1`.

mira_infra: yes, created PR and merged — helmrelease for infra-system has values overrides for regional registry. Flux should pick up. Flux reconcile command:
```
flux reconcile source git infra-charts --namespace infra-system
flux reconcile kustomization infra-asia-east1 --namespace infra-system
```

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: infra-asia-east1 (helm) — build: #4827 — status: started :rocket:

chen_sre: Checklist for validation:
- registry image count parity with us-west
- image digests match (sha256)
- helmrelease reconciliation within 5m
- nodepool GPU quota >= requested
- NAT egress for nodepools to reach gcr
- firewall rules allow artifact-repo CIDR

mira_infra: doing image parity check now: running `gcloud container images list-tags asia-east1.registry.redwood/llm-runtime --format=json | jq 'length'`

alex_dev: don't forget the artifact cache buckets — we need bucket lifecycle and appropriate IAM: `gs://redwood-artifact-cache-asia`.

mira_infra: sync script used:
```
./scripts/registry-sync --src gcr.io/redwood-artifacts --dest asia-east1.registry.redwood --concurrency=8 --verify-digest
```

opsbot: quota-check: GPUs requested 96, quota available 120 in asia-east1 :white_check_mark:

chen_sre: networking note: GKE nodepools in private cluster need egress NAT IPs for registry access. Confirmed NAT config: Cloud NAT attached to subnet `prod-asia-east1-a`.

mira_infra: Flux reports one HelmRelease stuck in "Progressing" due to missing secret for `registry-credentials`. Fixing now, applying secret:
```
kubectl create secret docker-registry registry-credentials -n infra-system \
  --docker-server=asia-east1.registry.redwood --docker-username=redwood-ci --docker-password=$TOKEN
```

alex_dev: after secret apply, do `flux reconcile kustomization infra-asia-east1` and watch `kubectl get hr -n infra-system`.

deploy-bot: build #4827 status: success — helm apply complete :tada:

mira_infra: final validations done: image parity OK (matches us-west), HelmRelease healthy, GPU quota OK, NAT + firewall ok. Leaving rollout handoff to @alex_dev for app teams and @chen_sre for SRE playbook.

alex_dev: ack, I'll ping product teams and open a tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-2319

chen_sre: noted, will add checklist to runbook and schedule a post-mortem if any propagation lag observed. Good job :clap:

mira_infra: thanks everyone — tagging infra-handoff channel for visibility. :shipit:
